reviews.text: This app doesn’t give you any new workouts. It tells you the same thing and doesn’t project anything new it’s not what you think.

reviews.title: Unhappy
reviews.text: I get in a grove with this app and then next thing I have to pay for it. At least wait for a month or so I can see some results!

reviews.title: Paywall
reviews.text: Used to be able to use basic features free. Now you only get 3 days.

reviews.title: Heart rate disappeared
reviews.text: I didn’t know why the heart rate disappeared when i start the workout out in the app, it was before very useful!!?

reviews.title: Lousy
reviews.text: I’ve been using it for over two years, but lately it keeps closing on its own. I have to open it every time I exercise, and it’s annoying that it keeps asking for permission to check my heart rate, something I’ve always refused. It’s stressful using it, and I hope they fix it.
